name: Exa Agent
description: Web research agent with its own search index. Send a task in plain language, optionally with a JSON Schema; get back schema-valid JSON with a citation for each field. Covers the open web plus people, company, paper and place indexes.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Exa API key as a Bearer token

skills.name: Research a question
skills.description: Searches the web, reads sources and returns a cited answer, or schema-valid JSON when a JSON Schema is sent. Effort sets depth: minimal $0.012 to xhigh $1.00 per task.
examples: What changed in the EU AI Act implementation timeline this month? Cite primary sources.
Compare the pricing pages of the top 5 vector databases as JSON.

skills.name: Build a list of companies or people
skills.description: Finds every company or person that matches criteria, using Exa's company and 1B+ people indexes, and returns rows with a citation per field.
examples: Series A-C fintechs in the EU that launched an AI agent in 2026, with a source for each.
Heads of data at US insurers with over 1,000 employees.

skills.name: Enrich rows you already have
skills.description: Takes rows as JSON and fills in missing fields (funding, headcount, tech used, recent news) with a citation for each value.
examples: For these 50 accounts, add last funding round, HQ country and whether they mention SOC 2.

skills.name: Watch for changes
skills.description: Re-runs a search on a schedule and pushes new results to your webhook. Built on Exa Monitors ($2 per 1,000 runs).
examples: Tell me when any of these 20 competitors changes pricing or announces a funding round.
